title: GET https://api.vox.photonind.com/integrations/entry/v1/door-stations (PhotonVox, for PhotonEntry; docs/VOX.md)
description: An organization's door stations in PhotonVox: the extensions of kind door_station, each with the SIP account an intercom registers with. Authorized by a per-organization token with scope vox:entry, made in PhotonVox and pasted into PhotonEntry. PhotonEntry refuses a document naming another organization than the one the token was connected for, and puts a station's SIP account on its intercom by provisioning (it is never shown to people).

organization_id.description: The organization's id in the PhotonID directory.

site_id.description: The directory site it is at, if any.

username.description: Both the register name and the auth name.

outbound_proxy.description: host:port the intercom sends its SIP through, when the SIP domain does not resolve to the engine from the customer's network (set by PhotonVox per engine; usually null). Optional; PhotonVox always sends it.

updated_at.description: When anything above last changed (a new SIP password included).
